lessons: Criteria contradict: AC3 forbids editing the three seeds on main yet requires a requisition_review approve for main's blob. Main's tickets/phase3-continue/ticket.md fails context_closure and idiom_mismatch, so no attempt can pass Check until that seed is fixed.

Fix the seed before re-dispatching, as commit 7130ee8 did. The successor phase3-continue-02 must embed a merged seeding test (tests/test_seeded_phase2.py or tests/test_seeded_phase3_core.py), never tests/test_seeded_phase3_01.py.
Make phase3-continue's prose idiom match its ## Context: name one seeding test in both places, so the implementer has a single template.

Amend AC3 and Scope out so the next attempt may re-author tickets/phase3-continue/ticket.md uncommitted for the seed-path lift, or record that a human fixed it on main. Keep the committed diff free of tickets/ paths (AC4).
The code branch is fine: tests/test_phase2_exit.py and tests/test_seeded_phase3_core.py pass and the full suite passed (684 tests). Reuse commit 529ef9b and don't re-author those tests.
